title: Too rigid and shallow to function like I’d like
text: Too rigid and shallow to function like I’d like. My kids currently have pottery barn kids lunch boxes, and those are both wider, deeper and have an exterior water bottle holder, so they fit a lot more. There are a couple Oxo divided containers we like to use, and even a large one with 3 sections (a large sandwich section and 2 sides) can be squished down in their PBK ones, and then there is room to fit ice packs and additional snacks on the top. This hydro flask one is simply too small and rigid for our needs. I think it would maybe work if you use a lot of ziplock bags, or if you plan on a small lunch for a toddler, but don’t plan on getting any sizable containers in this. I could basically fit a small container that would hold two sides, and there wasn’t even room left to squish the water bottle in there. I think it would end up being too small for most elementary kids.
